title: Lower bound for the code bound
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, let $H$ be the number of elements of $(	ext{Option } 	ext{State}(N))\times	ext{Fin}(3)$ and set $W=H+3k+1$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes. If its code bound is $2W+2$, then this bound is at least $2$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
